what_this_measures: the decision layer and requirement vocabulary, against hand-authored extractions. NOT extraction quality: the extractions were written with knowledge of the labels.
not_yet_measurable: extraction accuracy — needs the model-backed extractor
calibration and the operating point — decide() emits no probability yet
precision/recall per class — four positives in eleven fixtures is too thin to report
ranking_note: A divergence here means the layer triggered the labelled reason class and also triggered another, and the priority order (geography > product > functional > operations) put the other first. Two fixtures trigger geography AND operations, and their labels rank them in opposite directions, so no single priority order can reproduce both. Recorded rather than tuned.
